title: Employer Workplace Accommodations Form
description: Plain-language employer intake form focused on workplace support rather than medical questions.
doneMessage: Workplace accommodations saved for this job posting.

questions.label: Job title
questions.helpText: Use clear, everyday wording for the role.
questions.whyWeAsk: Helps job seekers find relevant roles.

questions.label: Hiring coordinator phone number
questions.helpText: Ethiopian phone numbers are normalized to +251XXXXXXXXX.
questions.whyWeAsk: Allows applicants or partner coordinators to confirm interview access.

questions.label: Work location arrangement
questions.helpText: Choose the flexibility available for this role.
questions.whyWeAsk: Candidates often filter roles by remote or flexible access.

questions.label: Workplace and interview support available
questions.helpText: Check every accommodation your team provides.
questions.whyWeAsk: Lists concrete workplace support transparently on the job card.

questions.label: Describe any extra support offered
questions.helpText: Describe adjustments you offer—never ask applicants for a medical diagnosis.

questions.label: Confirm privacy and non-medical pledge
questions.helpText: I confirm this posting describes workplace accommodations and does not ask candidates for medical proof or a diagnosis.
questions.whyWeAsk: Protects learner privacy across the gateway.
